requirements.general_text: Any of these: Matriculation/Foundation – minimum CGPA of 2.0 in relevant fields as recognized by the MOHE or its equivalent. DVM / DKM / DLKM – passed in relevant fields and undergo a screening and bridging program. Diploma – minimum CGPA of 2.0 in relevant field or it’s equivalent. A-Levels – Grade D in two subjects or it’s equivalent. UEC – minimum of 5 B’s including requisite subject. STPM – Grade C (GPA 2.0) in two subjects or it’s equivalent. STAM – minimum grade of Jayyid. 12 years of schooling – passed the exit qualification in the country of origin including requisite subject. English Requirements For International Students IELTS 5.0 or equivalent
